review: 702.46a-1: the no-target variants said the trigger is 'removed from the stack'; under 603.3d a trigger with no legal target is never put on the stack, so the expected text now says that.

702.46b-1 one_target: claimed the second trigger has no legal target, but both triggers can and must target Deathknell Kami (the only legal Spirit); rewrote it so the first returns the Kami and the second fizzles on resolution.

scenarios.title: Soulshift returns a Spirit card of mana value N or less from the graveyard when the permanent dies

setup.notes: Elder Pine of Jukai is a 2/1 Spirit with soulshift 2. Deathknell Kami is a Spirit with mana value 2.

decisions: B casts Shock targeting Elder Pine of Jukai, tapping the Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves and Elder Pine of Jukai dies in the state-based check.
A's soulshift trigger targets Deathknell Kami and A chooses to return it; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: spirit_in_range
variants.expected: Elder Pine of Jukai moves to A's graveyard. The soulshift trigger fires and Deathknell Kami moves from A's graveyard to A's hand.

variants.label: spirit_too_expensive
variants.delta: The Spirit card in A's graveyard is Thief of Hope (mana value 3) instead of Deathknell Kami.
variants.expected: Elder Pine of Jukai moves to A's graveyard. The soulshift trigger has no legal target, so it is not put on the stack; Thief of Hope stays in A's graveyard.

variants.label: not_a_spirit
variants.delta: The card in A's graveyard is Grizzly Bears (mana value 2, not a Spirit) instead of Deathknell Kami.
variants.expected: Elder Pine of Jukai moves to A's graveyard. The soulshift trigger has no legal target, so it is not put on the stack; Grizzly Bears stays in A's graveyard.

scenarios.title: Each instance of soulshift triggers separately

setup.notes: Forked-Branch Garami is a 4/4 green Spirit with two instances of soulshift 4. Deathknell Kami (mana value 2) and Elder Pine of Jukai (mana value 3) are Spirits.

decisions: B casts Doom Blade targeting Forked-Branch Garami, tapping both Swamps.
Both players pass; Doom Blade resolves and Forked-Branch Garami dies.
A puts both soulshift triggers on the stack; the first targets Deathknell Kami and the second targets Elder Pine of Jukai, and A chooses to return each. Both players pass and both resolve.

variants.label: two_targets
variants.expected: Forked-Branch Garami moves to A's graveyard. Two soulshift triggers fire and both Deathknell Kami and Elder Pine of Jukai move from A's graveyard to A's hand.

variants.label: one_target
variants.delta: The card in A's graveyard in place of Elder Pine of Jukai is Harbinger of Spring (mana value 5).
variants.expected: Forked-Branch Garami moves to A's graveyard. Both soulshift triggers are put on the stack, each targeting Deathknell Kami, the only legal target. The first to resolve returns Deathknell Kami to A's hand; the second has no legal target left on resolution and does not resolve. Harbinger of Spring stays in A's graveyard.

variants.label: survives
variants.delta: B casts Shock (tapping the Mountain) targeting Forked-Branch Garami instead of Doom Blade.
variants.expected: Forked-Branch Garami stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked. No soulshift trigger fires and both Spirit cards stay in A's graveyard.
